answer: The pourer tips his tallow from the kettle into the crocks, and the crocks must fill even or the fat sets lumpy. Taper potash candle roller grease bond is the tipping: a bond potash candle rollers lodge after rolling room checks. The raven is the first crock, filled at dawn; the lantern is the last, filled before the kettle is empty, and the ocean is the kettle itself, scraped clean at last. A counterfeiter faces 71 false crocks and 71 false kettles.
